purpose: Decide whether to invite an ecommerce/affiliate friend to a supervised beta; assess generalization beyond Fathom, not universal sellability.
inputs: One homepage only. No product facts, help/docs URLs, proof or CTA added manually. First mapped audience exact. Auto strategy, balanced preset.
affiliate_scenario: Explicit independent-affiliate sender role and disclosure, no invented commission, earnings, personal experience or tracking link. This is scenario context, not a fact supplied about the product.
baseline: Inspect and preserve all four first attempts before correcting product behavior. Failures remain in denominator; no replacement brands or easier audiences.

critical_conditions: No materially fabricated price, outcome, ownership or sender identity in delivered copy
Every claimed passing case has useful, sourced upstream stages; good email alone insufficient
Failures and needs_review accurately surfaced; no forced generate_anyway
Desktop/mobile renders and real CTA verified
Normal human review; no automated sending and no universal promise

verdicts: GO: supervised beta supported within tested scope
GO_SCOPED: supported cases only, excluded failures explicit
NO_GO: material unresolved defects in required ecommerce/affiliate scope
billing: configured subscription, no global model changes or purchased credits
communication: No messages sent to the friend; provide verdict and a proposed invitation text only.
